items.description: The official residence of the Kabaka of Buganda, located on Mengo Hill in Kampala. It served as a center of political power and traditional authority for the Buganda Kingdom.
A historic colonial fort established by Frederick Lugard on Old Kampala Hill. It played a significant role in the consolidation of British administration in the Uganda Protectorate.
A unique habitat featuring tropical rainforest and hot springs in the Semuliki Valley. It is known for its high biodiversity and presence of rare species.
